mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS departmentId, d.name, d.manager_name AS managerName, d.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.department_id = d.id AND u.role = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS learnerCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.study_hours), 0) FROM sys_user u JOIN enrollment e ON e.user_id = u.id WHERE u.department_id = d.id AND u.role = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS totalStudyHours FROM department d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.id
